# Jip Samhoud

> Brand builder, commercial leader and pioneer in creativity × technology, based in Amsterdam, the Netherlands. "I build concepts, companies and innovations that inspire and connect millions of people, and move society forward." From the world's first VR cinema to Let's Copilot. Available now, open to Chief AI Officer, CMO, Chief Digital Officer and General Manager roles, in the Netherlands or abroad.

## Profile

- Co-owner & director, &samhoud (160 FTE group; № 1 in management consultancy, MT500) — 2023–now
- Co-founder, Let's Copilot — AI-adoption SaaS for Microsoft Copilot; gamified onboarding and personalised prompt delivery at 100K+ users worldwide; featured in a talk by Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella — 2024–now
- Co-owner, &ranj serious games — Game Studio of the Year; 25 years of behaviour change through play for Johns Hopkins Institute, War Child and Zurich — 2023–now
- Founder & CEO (full P&L), &samhoud creative tech — 40+ FTE digital agency, Dutch Digital Agency of the Year; clients: Albert Heijn, Samsung, Rabobank, VodafoneZiggo; sold 2024 — 2013–2024
- Founder & CEO, The VR Cinema — the world's first permanent VR cinema; 20 locations in 10 countries, 3BN media reach — 2015–2018

## What I bring

- Builder — "Three months, not two years." From problem to concept to shipped product; eleven years of full P&L responsibility for a 40-FTE agency.
- Connector — "A network that opens doors." Fifteen years of relationships with corporate boards, social organisations and politics; fifteen Albert Heijn campaigns came out of one first project.
- Inspirator — "I can sell an idea." On stage, in the press and inside the team; international keynote speaker on AI, brand and society.
- Anchor — "Rots in de branding" (Dutch for the rock the waves break on). Stable, reliable, carries the outcome in good years and hard ones.

## Track record

- 4× companies founded; 40+ FTE agency built and sold; 10M+ app downloads across all ventures; €30M+ in new business won
- Albert Heijn kids loyalty engine (2013–2023): 15 campaigns, 5M+ downloads, 7M robots programmed
- Strategic advisor & fundraising committee, D66 & Rob Jetten (record €2.2M fundraising, 2025)
- Chairman, Dutch Advertising Community (Genootschap voor Reclame) — 2018–now
- Member, NL2025; former Youth Prime Minister of the Netherlands
- Education: Stanford GSB (AI & Innovation), Columbia (VC), Kellogg (Branding), Harvard Business School

## Beliefs

- "I build concepts, companies and innovations that inspire and connect millions of people, and move society forward."
- Six ventures, one pattern: a new technology, a brand built on top of it, and millions of people who actually used it.
- Building the next chapter, starting now.
